description:
**Phase C — Pure compaction core. Deps: A1.**

Port from `tmp/pi-mono/.../compaction/compaction.ts`:
- `estimateTokens` (lines 232-290) — chars÷4 heuristic per role; handles assistant thinking + tool calls.
- `estimateContextTokens` (lines 186-214) — uses last assistant `usage` as baseline + trailing-message estimate.
- `calculateContextTokens` (lines 135-137) — sums totalTokens or reconstructs from usage components.
- `shouldCompact` (lines 219-222) — exact signature: `shouldCompact(contextTokens, contextWindow, settings) -> contextTokens > contextWindow - settings.reserveTokens` (returns false if !settings.enabled).

Tests: parity against upstream estimator on fixture messages.
title: C1. Token estimator (estimate_tokens, estimate_context_tokens, should_compact?)
